description:
Activate Lotus Petal by tapping and sacrificing it, adding one mana of any color.
Activate Arcbound Reclaimer by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, putting Lotus Petal from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Hardened Academic triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on Arcbound Reclaimer.
Cast Lotus Petal from the top of your library by paying 0 life through Gwenom.
Repeat.
